identification: Mixed lot: 3 Dickens-era/classic books (Our Mutual Friend by Charles Dickens, Macmillan 1930 reprint, Kingswood House School Epsom prize label Xmas 1932; David Copperfield, marbled boards, Heath School Horsmonden prize label July 1914; Poems by Lord Tennyson, Pilgrim Press, illustrated by John Pellegrin/Pillegrin), a cut glass claret jug with silver plated (EPNS) mount and handle, and 2 pieces of cobalt blue and gilt 'Sevres style' porcelain (teapot and sugar bowl) with painted military/battle panels. No Sevres factory marks were photographed, so these are most likely 19th/early 20th century continental 'Sevres style' decorative ware rather than genuine Sevres.

viewing_check: Armitage estimate 30-60, current bid $25. Check the jug for chips and mount condition and look at the base of both porcelain pieces for marks (hand painted signature, Sevres-style interlaced L mark, repairs, lid fit on the teapot). Genuine Sevres would be worth far more than this estimate but the photos give no sign of it. Claret jug eBay AU sales are 2024 to 2026 at A$24 to A$88, steady. Terapeak AU found no sold results for 'Sevres teapot cobalt' or 'Sevres style teapot', so the porcelain has no sold comparison. The three books are 1914 to 1932-era prize editions and common.
